title: Local phase-modulated heterostructures for perovskite solar cells with high-efficiency and ultra-stability
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00897B, Paper
Yongjoon Cho, Donghwan Koo, Hak-Won Nho, Jeewon Park, Sangjin Yang, Ye-Jin Kim, Seonghun Jeong, Zhe Sun, Gyujeong Jeong, Eunbin Son, Oh-Hoon Kwon, Hyesung Park, Changduk Yang
An asymmetric Lewis base organic semiconductor, CY, was incorporated into the perovskite layer, enabling a local phase-modulated heterostructure that achieves 26.0% efficiency and excellent stability in perovskite solar cells.
